exposure: Genital tract colonization with GBS at the time of preterm premature rupture of membranes (PPROM)
genital tract colonization with GBS at the time of preterm premature rupture of membranes (PPROM)
cohort: Gravidas admitted with PPROM between 23 and 34 weeks of gestation
finding: Genital tract colonization with GBS at the time of preterm premature rupture of membranes (PPROM) does not appear to affect the latency period or increase the risk of intra-amniotic infection.
mod_finding: Among patients who underwent cesarean delivery, GBS-negative group had a higher risk of endomyometritis (25%) compared to the GBS-positive group (6%), p = 0.05.
